title: Too Much Power If Used in Smaller Glasses or Cups. Battery Compartment is Tight.
text:
Too Much Power If Used in Smaller Glasses or Cups. Battery Compartment is Tight.. If you are going to use this in an 8-ounce or 10-ounce glass or cup, don't bother. This mixer is too powerful. The liquid will splatter out.

If you're going to use this in a taller glass or cup where you do not fill up high, the mixer's power will mix the liquid fast and well.

Unfortunately, because this mixer doesn't have power settings, if you want to mix smaller ounces of liquid, you need to be using a much taller glass or cup.

Someone else has already mentioned the battery compartment here at Amazon. It really is very tight. I had a difficult time inserting the batteries.
